Paired elaborations: restraint after working out who did the damage (metroid-305a: miamidolphins-013; Russiaclan-6dbb: enterthegungeon-019); restraint grounded in membership of both rooms, K05 a candidate (CKCrusaders-0639 and foxes-15dd, each the other's pair). P11 opened for the re-check's first batch: 120 unruled lines (instantiate 91, add-step 13, link 10, restrict 5, add-condition 1). P11 is read by G16 as D3a-09 logged it, with its amendment of 18 October (QD3-007) (notes-D3.md lines 98 to 119): shown where members mark a work of the room's as up or achieved, at any hour: announcing it on the canvas, celebrating it, crediting makers and helpers (and credit disputes), a member claiming their part, saying what the work meant, an invitation to celebrate offline. The room's own word is enough. Not shown by a state report with no marking (P03), a placing told as a step, a call or prize to recruit (P01), saving images or the work's fate (P12), the contested version (P22), carrying on (P13), praise of another room's work, a bare mention or joke. G16's readings hold: 'done' marks the work when it is marked to the room; a work announced with no maker named is the room's; thanks to a helper of a standing work is P11's lower range, credit in a plan before the work is up is an elaboration; praise for spoiling a rival is A15. Marking where the close cut the work unfinished names A07's bound; marking any other ended attempt is a paired elaboration (QD3-007: a P11 subform for the clustering). Successor canvases: paired elaborations. Pairs on P11 only (G4); checked by d3b_pair_element_check.py.

Specifications naming A07's bound, where hour 73 cut the work unfinished and the room marks the attempt: aeon-2241 (close to finished when it ended, thanks to all who tried), chess-3232 (a knight started just before the end, thanks for it), DiamondClub-7da0 ('place ended before they could finish but they got the diamond down'). futanari-d9d4, members praising pictures of 'our place', a specification. Paired elaboration: kamenrider-6f1a, 'we didn't achieve our goals, but at least we got a part of Mighty', a part left after the goal failed (QD3-007), as kamenrider-022 was ruled at D3a-13, paired with faeria-048.
